name: Four Seasons Nashville
positioning: Downtown Nashville hotel in the SoBro neighbourhood, one block from Broadway, with a seventh-floor pool terrace overlooking the Cumberland River
best_for: Travelers who want a base one block from Broadway's live music and nightlife
Guests who want a seventh-floor pool terrace overlooking the Cumberland River

facts.text: Hotel accommodations span the 7th to 14th floors of the building.
The hotel is at 100 Demonbreun Street, Nashville, TN 37201.
The hotel is in downtown's SoBro area, one block from Broadway.
The property is 8 miles (13 kilometres) from Nashville International Airport.
Rivière Rooftop is on the hotel's seventh-floor pool deck.
The spa has six treatment rooms, including a couple's suite.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.

highlights.text: The River-View Room has a floor-to-ceiling panorama of the Cumberland River, Nissan Stadium and lush green park space.
The hotel has an infinity-edge pool on the seventh-level terrace.
The hot tub is open year round.
The Songwriter Experience is a one-hour performance in your suite by a Nashville-based number one hit songwriter.
The hotel offers a VIP guided tour of the Ryman Auditorium.

considerations.text: The spa and salon are open daily 8:30 am – 6:00 pm.
The hotel is one block from Broadway with its live music and nightlife.
WhataHotel notes a busy downtown location with urban noise levels.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
